subject: Unexpected overcount on May 1 invoice — topology sync suspected
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@brightcart.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 2 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected overcount on May 1 invoice — can you help?

Hi Nikhil,

We're reviewing our May 1st invoice and see ~18% higher token counts vs our internal telemetry for the 00:00–04:00 UTC window. This is triggering an overage that will push us past our monthly commit.

Quick details:
- Account: BrightCart / BRIGHT-2345
- Affected routes: /v1/chat/stream (embedding jobs look normal)
- Suspect window: 2027-05-01 00:00:00–04:00 UTC

Can you confirm whether any platform maintenance, topology changes, or replication events could have caused duplicate ingest during that window? If you need logs, I can share request IDs — I've attached a small sample we pulled from our side.

Would appreciate a timeline for investigation and whether you can provisionally hold the overage charge while this is investigated.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Director, Platform Engineering
BrightCart

Attachments: ingest-sample-requests-20270501.csv (CSV, 120 rows)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@brightcart.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 2 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected overcount on May 1 invoice — can you help?

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and the sample. I've looped in Kimberly from Billing so she can review invoice hold options while we investigate.

Plan:
1) I will pull the server-side ingress logs for the suspect window and check for duplicate request IDs / replayed websocket frames.
2) If we see duplicates, we'll trace to any topology sync/rolling deploys and capture exact service timestamps.
3) We'll propose a provisional credit if the overcount is internal and provide evidence.

Can you also send one or two full request IDs (not just the extracted rows) so I can match to our request-id traces? If you prefer, upload them to the Drive link in your reply.

I'll get an initial update within 24 hours. —Nikhil

--
Nikhil Sharma
Account Lead, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 2 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: BrightCart overcount — initial findings and invoice hold?

Kimberly / Ben — forwarding Elena's note. I pulled a quick sample from our request tracing for the 00:30–01:30 UTC window and found a small cluster of duplicated request-IDs that align with a node rebalancing operation we ran across the metric-plane at 00:46 UTC on May 1 (we were rolling a topology sync to reduce KV hot-shards).

Preliminary notes:
- Duplicate cluster: ~14k extra tokens attributable to duplicated ingestion for that route.
- Root cause hypothesis: a transient reconnect / double-ack during topology sync where client socket reconnect + short replay led to re-ingestion before dedupe completed.
- Evidence: server traces + per-request hash match (I exported a snapshot).

Ben — can you confirm whether this is something we can attribute to internal replay handling? If so, can Billing prepare a provisional credit to offset the overage (we should propose full credit for duplicated tokens) and hold collection pending confirmation?

I've attached the trace export and the billing snapshot: billing-snapshot-20270501.json (contains per-route attribution). Also linking the HubSpot ticket: HUBSPOT-67821.

Thanks,
Nikhil

Attachments: billing-snapshot-20270501.json (JSON, server-side snapshot), ingest-sample-requests-20270501.csv

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@brightcart.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected overcount on May 1 invoice — topology sync suspected

Hi Elena — thanks for your patience and for the sample IDs. We completed a short forensic review overnight. Summary below and next steps.

Summary:
- Cause: Confirmed duplicated ingestion during a topology sync/deployment at 2027-05-01 00:46:12 UTC. A small subset of websocket sessions did a reconnect + replay that bypassed our short-term dedupe window due to an edge case in our topology handoff logic.
- Impact: ~18,320 extra tokens billed to BrightCart for the /v1/chat/stream route during 00:30–01:10 UTC. This matches Elena's observed delta (~18%).
- Mitigation: Engineering has patched the handoff logic; the fix prevents replay from being processed when the session is flagged as 'in-flight' during handoff. We've scheduled a canary verification and will monitor the next three rolling deploys.

Resolution proposal:
1) We will issue a one-time credit equal to the duplicated tokens (provisional credit of $1,642.80), applied to the May invoice.
2) We will place the overage portion of the invoice on hold until credit posts (Billing will not initiate collection on that line item).
3) We'll provide the server trace export and a short summary for your finance team (attached).

If that sounds good, Elena, I'll schedule the credit and send an updated invoice PDF and ledger entry (~24–48 hours). Apologies for the disruption — we aim to make production deploys non-impacting and will follow up with a short postmortem for your records.

Next steps for us: Ben will create the credit entry and update HUBSPOT-67821 with the ledger id. Nikhil will share the final trace packet.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Billing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: billing-snapshot-20270501.json
